pr_title: Warn when project-specific settings are passed to non-project `uv run` commands
pr_comments: Is this the only interface this applies to? Thank you!
Arguably also `no_workspace` in `uv init` (warn if you're not in a workspace).

issue_context.title: Warn when project options are used with `uv run` outside a project
issue_context.body:
e.g., `--dev`, `--no-dev`, `--extra`, `--all-extras`, `--no-all-extras`

Maybe , `--no-project`.

These appear to be ignored right now, e.g.

```
❯ uv run --dev --extra foo script.py
warning: `uv run` is experimental and may change without warning
Reading inline script metadata from: script.py
```

review_comments: We could enforce these _specific_ warnings via Clap, and make them errors. But the others must be done at runtime, because we don't _know_ if we'll discover a project when we first parse the arguments. So I just did them all as warnings for consistency.
